effect: The outer cloud avoids the main collision and is drawn outward by the approaching galaxy's unequal pull, completing the gas goal.
reaction: I was interested that gas could leave the spiral without being burned or broken.

mostWorthwhile.text: The dense-gas collision was most worthwhile: it clearly contrasted the clouds' compression and cooling with the stars passing between one another.

leastWorthwhile.text: Following the remaining cloud was the least engaging choice because it was the only offered gameplay action, although its outcome was informative.

surprise.text: The outer cloud missed the main collision yet was drawn outward along with stars.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the cloud's placement was less obviously connected to the gas goal beforehand, but its result explained the connection.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to follow the different gas portions into later encounters, especially after seeing how density changed their immediate outcomes.
